rules: No martingale. I never double up my lot size to win back a loss.
Be patient. Wait for a good entry point, not just any entry.
Trade a lot size that doesn't stress me: I can enter, set my take profit and put my phone down without worrying the account might blow.
Don't over-expose. Max lots open at once: 0.3 to 0.5 on the 100K, 0.15 to 0.25 on the 50K, depending on market conditions. Recovery entries count too.

days.lesson: One trade went against me, so I added 2 recovery entries lower and closed all three together once the group was in profit. It worked today, but adding to a losing trade raises the risk, so I need to keep it within my daily loss limit.
Waited for a retracement that hardly came. No forced trades.
Small, steady steps. It's never about the big flashy wins.
FOMC day, so the market was very volatile. Without discipline, the account would surely be in danger.
Kept adding buys as gold kept dropping and ended up with more lots open than my rule allows. Closest I've come to the daily limit. Back to small and patient.
